name: finalize
description: Call at end of call to commit the authoritative extraction. Pass the full verbatim transcript and the incidentId so the system can merge LLM-extracted data into the provisional record. Always call this before disconnecting.

request_body_schema.description: Finalize the incident with the full call transcript.

incidentId.description: id returned by create_incident_provisional. If missing, a new incident will be created from the transcript.
